verdict.rationale: Publishing an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for any software product with documentation, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions an llms.txt file or docs written for agents. The raw-Markdown help repos and the headless Sync client, which mentions agents, are adjacent features and do not count as agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
